about_short_description.short_description: SH Financial offers a broad spectrum of payment solutions, capital, and digital treasury services.

product.name: International Business Accounts
product.description: SH Financial provides international business accounts enabling cross-border payments, transactional FX, IBANs, vIBANs, multi-currency wallets, and VISA card issuance.

product.name: Capital Investment Services
product.description: SH Capital offers services in capital investment including family office, corporate office, and consulting in wealth & asset management.

product.name: Cryptocurrency Liquidity and Trading Services
product.description: SH Digital provides cryptocurrency liquidity and trading services, operating with a VASP registration in Lithuania and a license in Dubai.

identifier.value: Stablecoin Issuance for the Travel Industry

product.name: Stablecoin Issuance for the Travel Industry
product.description: SH Financial issues stablecoins pegged to USD, GBP, and Euros for the travel industry, ensuring transactions are backed by fiat currency in a secure EU regulated bank account.

identifier.value: Banking Services for SMEs and Regulated Institutions

product.name: Banking Services for SMEs and Regulated Institutions
product.description: Licensed as an Electronic Money Institute, SH Financial offers banking services tailored for SMEs, regulated institutions, and virtual asset service providers.
